verdict.rationale: Zep automatically extracts entities/relations into a Context Graph and generates natural-language thread summaries and fact-based knowledge graph updates, which count as AI-generated insights from ingested data (zep-docs-8, zep-docs-27, zep-gh-1). However these are developer-facing memory/context primitives delivered via API/SDK rather than end-user-facing 'suggestions' or proactive recommendations surfaced in a product UI. Missing for 10: evidence of proactive suggestion generation, a user-facing insights dashboard, or recommendation features beyond summarization/fact-extraction.
